Hi Maria — great to hear the demo landed well. Quick answers and suggested next steps: 

1) Term length: We can put together a 24-month Private Offer via AWS Marketplace. It will change billing cadence and commit calculations (we typically price for 12/24/36). For a 24-month term we recommend an annual-invoice option (we'll reflect commit and enable overage rules in the offer).

2) Discount: 30% is above standard marketplace private-offer thresholds for self-serve. To get to 30% we need an approved discount exception (sales + finance + GTM manager signoff). I can start the exception thread if you confirm the annual commitment band.

3) Buyer approvers: On the buyer side you typically need: Procurement (to accept PO/Marketplace offer), Finance (budget/AR approval), and Security/Infosec (SOC2 review + data residency confirmation). On our side, internal approvers will be Sales Manager (Vanessa), Finance Lead (Marcus), and Legal if there are term deviations.

Action items: 
- Maria: Can you confirm committed annual spend band for the 24-month scenario (estimated $/yr)?
- FinVertex Procurement: please confirm whether your legal team requires a separate master services agreement or whether accepting the AWS private offer suffices.
- Vanessa/Marcus: tagging you for discount exception cadence and a quick pricing check.

I'll attach a draft private-offer terms doc for transparency.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
